items: 1 × 16 oz can red beans, drained twice
4 medium onions (fewer okay), sliced, sautéed in bacon drippings
½ cup cider or wine vinegar

steps.title: Fry the bacon
steps.body: Fry **5 slices bacon** and crumble it.

steps.title: Sauté the onions
steps.body: Sauté **4 medium onions** (fewer okay), sliced, in the bacon drippings.

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Combine: the onions, **½ cup cider or wine vinegar**, **½ cup brown sugar**, **1 tsp dry mustard**, **1 tsp garlic powder**, **2 × 15 oz cans butter beans**, drained, **1 × 16 oz can lima beans**, drained, **1 × 16 oz can red beans**, drained twice, and **1 × 24 oz can baked beans**, undrained.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Sprinkle the bacon on top and bake, covered, for 1 hour at 300°F.
